findings.text: The right-hand music credit ends around x1145, inside the declared right 63px inset (safe edge x1107). This is nonessential text, but the footer does not share the menu's safe-area discipline.
findings.suggestion: Inset footer credits by the same safe-area margin as the menu content.

findings.text: The second roster block loses its BENCH heading in the 16:10 render, although the corresponding heading is visible at 16:9 and 19:9. The lineup/reserve distinction is less explicit.
findings.region: left roster between starters and Dain/Pike/Orr, y338–360
findings.suggestion: Anchor BENCH above the second block after the taller-layout calculation, with a reserved label row.

findings.text: Vaughn's actions are Release then Extend; Ardry's are Extend then Release. Adjacent cards reverse the placement of the destructive action. Whether this causes wrong taps needs testing, but the inconsistency is visible.
findings.region: captain action buttons below the two cards
findings.suggestion: Use one fixed Extend/Release order for every captain card and keep the destructive action visually separated.

findings.text: The roughly 520×300 venue panel is a flat field containing the venue name/capacity again and a badge. It conveys less of a club-owned physical ground than the accompanying description promises.
findings.suggestion: Use a small pixel-art venue illustration for the current stage, retaining capacity and the club badge as overlays; let upgrades visibly change the ground.

findings.text: Action, chance and consequence text rotate with each wedge, including an almost vertical Takedown/Bullrush label. Comparing the three options requires reading several orientations; the small raster letters lose clarity at these angles.
findings.suggestion: Keep action names and probability/effect lines horizontal on compact plates aligned with their wedges; retain the wedge hit areas and sport-specific effects.

findings.text: The open wheel covers the fifth fighter's bottom card and part of the opponent's standing panel. At 1170px wide the far-right 105px gutter remains available above it, while the overlapping HUD loses context.
findings.region: opponent HUD and bottom-right fighter status behind wheel
findings.suggestion: Reserve a prompt region or relocate compact option plates so standing counts and the selected fighter's status stay unobscured; do not stretch the locked list.

findings.text: The full-playbook modal's header uses smooth sans-serif lettering while its cards and surrounding fight UI use the pixel font. This is a conspicuous typographic change inside the same interaction.
findings.suggestion: Use the established pixel-font header style, with wrapping or a shorter title rather than a fallback font.

findings.text: Done picking favourites and Back to the corner are equally weighted exit-like actions, without explaining whether Done returns to the corner or changes an editing mode. In the pre-bout renders, 'Back to the corner' also names a different context from the walk-out beneath it.
findings.suggestion: If Done commits favourites and returns, make that one primary exit; otherwise name the mode change explicitly and visually distinguish it from Back to the corner. Use 'Back to the plan' or the actual opener's name before a bout.

findings.text: Back and Walk out remain visible beneath the route coach mark, superimposed on live-fight fighter cards. The render mixes pre-bout actions with the fight's HUD; whether this is a fixture artifact or a live transition defect needs reproduction.
findings.region: bottom-left Back and bottom-centre Walk out behind dimmer
findings.suggestion: Reproduce the first-bout transition, then hide the walk-out controls before drawing the live fight/coach mark; correct the shot fixture instead if production already does that.

findings.text: The footer's red -33 differential runs directly into 'now at full steel', so the statistic and grade read as one continuous string.
findings.region: bottom-right summary inside the record panel, y410
findings.suggestion: Give the differential a fixed-width total cell with at least one text-space of padding, and place the current grade in a separate labelled footer field.

findings.text: The CHAMPION heading fits near the bottom of Your Path, but the winning club's name straddles the panel's bottom border. The most celebratory result gets the least stable placement.
findings.region: right Your Path panel, CHAMPION and Detroit Free at y425–454
findings.suggestion: Reserve a complete champion footer inside the panel or shorten the round summaries enough to give the winner its own padded row.

findings.text: The pre-bout full playbook is drawn without the opaque panel/backdrop seen in the corner version. Louisville and both clubs' stats remain between and behind its title, cards and ordering instructions, merging two screens' content.
findings.region: entire overlay, especially title y80–110 and ordering instruction y378–400
findings.suggestion: Give the pre-bout editor the same opaque modal panel and dimmer as the corner editor; reproduce in the live transition to distinguish game behavior from shot setup.

findings.text: The wide mark-colour popup centres around x689 rather than x585, and the dimmer leaves the leftmost 105px as a uniform grey strip. This is a visible frame/overlay-offset mismatch, not useful side padding.
findings.region: full modal and left x0–104 strip
findings.suggestion: Position the modal and scrim in the same coordinate space: apply the wide-frame offset once, cover the full viewport and centre within the safe content rect.

findings.text: Tournament cells truncate to BALTIMORE..., while the sidebar contains both Baltimore Open and Baltimore Classic. The distinguishing event name disappears from the dated cells.
findings.region: calendar dates 16–18 and sidebar event list
findings.suggestion: Wrap the event suffix onto a second line or use distinct short labels such as 'B. Classic'; keep the full name available on selection.

findings.text: THE SEASON and 'now: weekdays' touch in the right-hand panel header with no stable separation.
findings.suggestion: Put the current phase on a separate line beneath the panel heading.

findings.text: Face, Kit and Beard controls sit beside a portrait box that only says 'art to follow'. The player cannot see the appearance these choices produce, and unfinished production wording reaches the new-career flow.
findings.region: coach portrait preview and appearance controls
findings.suggestion: Render the selected coach appearance; until that exists, remove the appearance controls without a visible preview and the development placeholder from the player flow.
